summary_1line: Yudhishthira enters exile with followers; Brahmanas insist on accompanying him, and a sage teaches detachment from wealth and desire while Yudhishthira defends duties of hospitality.

image_candidates.scene_text: The grieving Pandavas sit beneath a vast banyan tree by the Ganges at dusk while Brahmanas light sacred fires and chant the Vedas around them.
Yudhishthira, weeping and seated on the bare ground in exile, listens as the sage Saunaka speaks to him about the dangers of attachment and wealth.
At dawn in the forest’s edge, a group of mendicant Brahmanas stand before the Pandavas insisting on following them into the wilderness.
